verdict_reason: Paging is wired in correctly with role-wide counts and links that carry the search text and chosen address, but the new page-offset in each row's idPrefix is untested.

todos.issue: resultRows now numbers each row's idPrefix by its place across all pages (party-${from + index + 1}, so page 2 renders 'party', 'party-10', 'party-11'...), but no test asserts an idPrefix beyond the first row's 'party' (test-support.js:9, party-picker.controller.test.js:667). Removing 'from +' leaves every test green, so the new page-offset rule is unproven, and ids only need to be unique within the one rendered page.
todos.fix: Must: the rule for a row's idPrefix on a later page is either page-independent (and the from parameter goes) or pinned by a test that fails when the offset is removed. One way: drop the from argument so ids run 'party', 'party-2'... on every page, or add a controller test on page 2 asserting picker.rows[1].idPrefix is 'party-10'.
